in_marathi.name: Gunvant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunvant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gunvant is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. In Hindu mythology, it is believed to represent the power and bravery of a warrior. The name is often given to boys as a symbol of strength and courage.
